name: Quiksilver
note: Official Partner of the NorthStar SailGP Team (SailGP press release and ABG press release, 16 Jan 2026). The SailGP team page spells the partner name 'Quicksilver'; the brand and ABG spell it 'Quiksilver'. Left unrated for a maintainer, following the reebok precedent: Quiksilver is a brand of Boardriders, which Authentic Brands Group acquired on 1 September 2023 (FashionNetwork, 3 Sep 2023; ABG release, 16 Jan 2026). ABG's own Shareholders & Leadership page lists GIC, Temasek and Qatar Investment Authority among its shareholders (logo list, no stakes disclosed), and none of those funds appears on the board ABG lists. Whether any state fund holds 5% or more of ABG is not publicly sourced; if one does, this would be Concern (see reebok).
